## What and why

## How it was tested

Commands you actually ran, and anything skipped. A skipped test is not a pass.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint typecheck test` passes
- [ ] `make test-integration` passes, if this touches the sandbox, runtime or external agents
- [ ] A regression test covers any real defect
- [ ] Docs changed in the same pull request
- [ ] No evidence, frozen registration or ledger was edited by hand
- [ ] No script or fixture is described as a model
